summary: Retest of the iteration_57 Square fixes. Everything requested passes. Backend: test_square_payments.py with -n 0 gives 17/17. A new test file, test_square_retry_locks.py, gives 3/3. It checks that a failed autopay charge is retried after a card replacement and gets paid without IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (the log count stayed at 4, all from before the fix at 15:10-15:11). It also checks that an invoice locked in db.square_locks is skipped by autopay, that a manual pay followed by run-billing produces only one Square payment, and that the all-or-nothing manual lock releases the partial lock and returns 409. Frontend (390x844, real typing into Square's nested card iframe): (1) the customer flow on MD1001 (unlock 0100, PAY CA$48.03 BY CARD, card 4111/12/30/111/12345) lands on /customer/paid?code=MD1001 showing PAYMENT RECEIVED CA$48.03 with Visa ••1111. The tracking page then shows a PAYMENT label with a PAID pill and VIEW PAYMENT CONFIRMATION. (2) Merchant REPLACE CARD: without the checkbox ticked the page shows 'Tick the box to authorize automatic charges'. With it ticked, the toast reads 'Visa ••1111 SAVED · AUTOPAY IS ON' and the card shows 'EXPIRES 12/2030 · SAVED OCT 29, 2026'. (3) Invoice DL-000032 (TEST_ invoice): SELECT TO PAY, then PAY BY CARD, then the real card form. The toast reads 'PAYMENT RECEIVED · CA$13.56 · 1 INVOICE PAID · RECEIPT EMAILED' and the invoice shows PAID; the database has exactly one Square charge for it. Remaining issues are minor: receipt emails fail for good on provider 429 / 422 while the confirmation screen still says 'RECEIPT SENT TO'; Square fonts are blocked by the CSP; BACK TO MY ORDER stacks a duplicate tracking screen. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Still sent once with no retry. During this run the provider returned 429 'email rate limit exceeded' three times in a row for the customer receipt (2 API pays about 30 s apart), and customer_payment.receipt_email stayed 'failed: Email provider error 429'. Emails do go out when not rate limited (202 at 15:27:31). Add a retry/backoff queue.

Locks have no TTL or expiry. If the process dies between lock_invoices/take_lock and the finally block, inv:{id} / order:{id} stay locked forever. Autopay then silently skips the invoice every cycle, and manual pay returns 409 'already being processed'. Add an expireAfterSeconds index on 'at' (store a datetime) or clear stale locks in billing_watcher.

minor.endpoint: run_auto_billing weekly key (hash of invoice ids)
minor.issue: When the unpaid weekly set changes after a failed attempt (an invoice is added or paid), a new key/doc is made, and the old 'failed' doc is never retried or closed. It stays in RECENT CHARGES as 'failed · will retry' forever. Mark superseded weekly docs (for example status 'superseded') when a new key is created for the same merchant+monday.
stripe==14.4.1 is still listed (line 116), left over from the Stripe removal.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows the email as sent even when customer_payment.receipt_email is 'failed: ...' (seen with 422 undeliverable and 429). Show 'RECEIPT EMAIL' plus the status, or hide 'sent' when it failed.

It calls router.replace('/customer/CODE') while the tracking screen is still under it in the stack (it was pushed from OrderPayment), so two tracking screens end up stacked: Playwright found 2 [data-testid=order-payment-view], one hidden. The header back button then returns to the same order again. Use router.back() when canGoBack().

The label '1 invoice(s) paid by card' should handle the plural properly.
The PAID row shows only the time ('11:26') with no date.

critical_code_review_comments: auto_charge now builds the idempotency key as f'{key[:30]}:{uuid4().hex[:12]}' per attempt. That fixes the reuse after save_card resets attempts. A side effect is that a network timeout after Square actually charged would be retried with a new key on the next cycle, which could double charge. billing_watcher only resets 'processing' docs that have no payment_id, so the window is small but not zero. Consider storing the per-attempt key on the doc before calling Square and reusing it if the previous attempt ended with NETWORK.
lock_invoices is all-or-nothing and is used by both manual pay and autopay; verified by tests. Both paths re-read the invoices as unpaid after taking the lock, which is correct.
square.py is 601 lines; the inline hosted page HTML/JS could move to its own module.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (customer pay -> confirmation, replace card, invoice pay by card); minor UI notes only
